extracted.name: Hearty Slow Cooker Beef Stew
extracted.description: A hearty slow cooker beef stew recipe is veggie-packed and made with reduced-sodium beef broth and loads of garlic, perfect for a chilly fall day.
ingredient_lines: 2 pounds beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes
0.75 pound butternut squash, peeled and cut into small chunks
0.5 head escarole, washed and torn into bite-sized pieces
instruction_lines: Place beef in a slow cooker. Combine flour, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl, sprinkle over beef, and toss to coat. Add carrots, potatoes, squash, broth, onion, celery, garlic, paprika, Worcestershire sauce, and bay leaf. Cover the slow cooker.
Cook on Low for 10 to 12 hours, or on High for 4 to 6 hours. Stir in escarole; cover and cook until escarole is tender, 15 to 20 minutes more.
